t: The first thing created, and what it was told
a: قَالَ رَبِّ وَمَاذَا أَكْتُبُ قَالَ اكْتُبْ مَقَادِيرَ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ حَتَّى تَقُومَ السَّاعَةُ
p: Qāla rabbi wa mādhā aktub. Qāla: uktub maqādīra kulli shayʾin ḥattā taqūma-s-sāʿah
m: It said: my Lord, what shall I write? He said: write the measures of everything, until the Hour comes.
